head.t: Digital patient monitoring system among innovative projects to improve cancer services across the Humber
head.x: Humber and North Yorkshire Cancer Alliance has awarded a share of £135,000 to three projects run by Humber Health Partnership aiming to improve cancer services and outcomes for patients.

head.t: Free webinar series to support pharmacists in diabetes and obesity care
head.x: The Diabetes & Obesity Pharmacy Alliance is launching a series of free webinars to help pharmacists navigate the evolving landscape of diabetes and obesity care, with sessions exploring injectable therapies, medicines optimisation and the complexities of patient care.
